VALIDATION_FAILED: Some fields are not valid. Please review them.
NOT_FOUND: The requested item was not found.
CONFLICT: This conflicts with an existing record (for example, a duplicate code).
RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
INTERNAL_ERROR: The server could not complete the request. Please try again.
TOKEN_EXPIRED: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
TOKEN_REUSED: Your session was ended for security reasons. Please sign in again.
ACCOUNT_DISABLED: This account is disabled. Contact your manager.
INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSION: You do not have permission to do this.
CSRF_REJECTED: The request was blocked for security reasons.
INVALID_MODIFIER_SELECTION: The selected options are not valid for this product.
INVALID_ORDER_STATE: This action is not allowed in the order's current status.
PAYMENT_FAILED: The payment could not be completed.
SYNC_CONFLICT: This change conflicts with a newer version.
RESTAURANT_OFFLINE: The restaurant is offline right now.
ONLINE_ORDERING_DISABLED: Online ordering is not available right now.
NETWORK_ERROR: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection.
INVALID_RESPONSE: The server sent an unexpected response.
